verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs explicitly describe an invisible CAPTCHA/bot check ('An invisible CAPTCHA that protects against sophisticated bots without challenges' and 'Protect sensitive routes from sophisticated bots with an invisible check instead of a CAPTCHA'), directly matching the story. This is complemented by broader firewall/rules-based bot blocking. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the invisible challenge's effectiveness and no third-party benchmarking of bypass rates.
